summary: A running session keeps the adapter and core pair it started with: the adapter invokes the core at its own release path, the installer retains a release while a live session references it, and a breaking store migration applies only through an explicit operator upgrade that refuses under a live older session. An installer facing a pending breaking step or unknown readiness prepares the candidate durably and names the exact migration and activation commands; the incompatible migration and its cleanup run inside a maintenance boundary whose session-admission exclusion is held through the final lease check, the migration, and the activation. No refusal names a session restart as its recovery.
title: A release never requires a session restart
